product: NOAA/CIMSS-GMU VIIRS flood composite (staged by MoM production)
pixel_meaning: count of processed source rasters in which this pixel's value fell in the band's value set

bands.meaning: flood (MoM production's VIIRS flood threshold, value > 140)

source_class_values.130-200: floodwater fraction codes, higher means more open water

removed_bands.meaning: lower floodwater-fraction codes below that threshold
removed_bands.reason: unused by the analyses; dropped to reduce file size

compression: ZSTD level 9 (rewritten from LZW when band 2 was dropped)
